title: Patient Health Questionnaire-2 (depression, ultra-brief)
description: The first two items of the PHQ-9 under the PHQ-9 stem (instruction manual, Table 1: "First 2 items of PHQ-9. Ultra-brief depression screener").

citation.text: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW (2003). The Patient Health Questionnaire-2: validity of a two-item depression screener. Medical Care 41(11):1284–1292.

source.note: Items 1–2 of the English PHQ-9 form; the manual defines the PHQ-2 as those items.

scoring.text: Sum of the two items (0–6), in phq2_total. The manual: "the recommended cutpoints for each when used as screeners is a score of 3 or greater".

items.label: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

rows.label: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
